template.title: Answer common support questions with your own replies; send the rest to a person
template.author: claude-opus-5-5 (frontier author; hand-written 2026-10-21 for research/surface-20261021 BUILDER-1)
template.whenToUse: Someone wants open support tickets that ask a common question (matched by a keyword) answered with a reply they wrote, and every other ticket, and every urgent one, sent to a person in one digest.
template.notFor: AI-written or translated answers, closing or editing tickets, refunds, live chat, or answering every ticket automatically.
sources: experiments/library/cards/catalog.json P09 judge -> confidence gate -> review queue (escalate, never guess)
small-business ticket deflection pattern (escalate urgent and unmatched tickets to a person)

slots.name: answers
slots.description: Canned replies: when a ticket's subject or text contains the keyword, it gets this reply. Use the person's own facts only.

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: A word that customers will write when they ask this question, matched anywhere in the subject or text, ignoring case. Prefer a short stem: 'ship' matches shipping and shipped, 'return' matches returns and returning, 'hour' matches hours and opening hours. Several entries may share one reply.

fields.name: reply
fields.description: The answer to send, in the person's words and facts; no promises they did not make.

slots.name: escalateTo
slots.question: Who should get the tickets that need a person? (one e-mail address)
slots.askWhy: Tickets contain customers' messages; I will not guess where they go.
slots.description: E-mail address that gets the digest of tickets a person must handle.

data.tickets: one row per ticket: id, from (customer e-mail), subject, body, priority (normal | urgent), status (open | closed)

willDo: Answer a ticket automatically only when it mentions one of your keywords ([[keywordsText]]) and is not urgent, with your reply for that keyword
Send every other ticket, including every urgent one, to [[escalateTo]] in one digest
Check, by re-reading the outbox, that exactly the planned e-mails went out
willNotDo: Write new answers: it only sends the replies you gave
Run by itself: you (or your coding agent) start each run

answers.reply: Orders ship within 3 to 5 business days.
Use the Forgot password link on the login page.

workflow.title: Support ticket answers and escalation
workflow.goal: Each run, answer the open, non-urgent tickets that mention a known keyword with the person's reply for it, and send every other open ticket to [[escalateTo]] in one digest, after a person approves each e-mail.

assumptions: The tickets sheet holds one row per ticket with id, from, subject, body, priority and status
Delivery is a local outbox file standing in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
risks: An urgent or unusual ticket answered by a canned reply
successCriteria: Every open ticket was either answered with a matching reply or sent to the person
No urgent ticket was answered automatically
This run delivered exactly the planned e-mails, each intact (checked by re-reading the outbox)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself

nodes.description: Decide for each ticket: a known answer, or a person (urgent tickets always go to a person)
The tickets with a known answer
The tickets a person must handle
Urgent tickets among the automatic answers (used by a check: must be none)

args.text:
Hi,

Thanks for getting in touch about "{{subject}}".

{{answer}}

If this does not answer your question, just reply to this e-mail and a person will pick it up.

[[signature]]

List the tickets for a person
Write the digest for the person
E-mail the digest to [[escalateTo]] (asks you first)
